title: Flintcore
body:
# Flintcore - Weapon, Ammunition, Attachments Library
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5d002f15f3c723106055ec4a581e5886c40a9143_0.webp)

Basic weapon core, firstly derived from hyper-improvement of Flint'N'Powder, and lately cut off into seperate library.

Allows to easily create **guns, ammunition and attachments**, also allowing interaction between different mods using tag system.

Source code: https://github.com/Livelandr/flintcore

**Currently in Beta**, please, report found bugs to [our Discord Server](https://discord.gg/zhPhzqA6Hw).
